description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and acrificing Vigor.
When Vigor dies, it and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Vigor trigger, shuffling it into your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Vigor and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Vigor enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
